lobby.support.greeting: Hi {name}! I'm your live assistant — ask me anything about deposits, withdrawals, bonuses or games.
lobby.support.greetingGuest: Welcome to DB AIRS! I'm your live assistant — ask me anything about deposits, withdrawals, bonuses or games.
lobby.support.disclaimer: AI answers are for reference only. Money-related requests are handled by a human agent.
lobby.support.reply.deposit: First check that the amount and order number on your receipt match. Crypto deposits usually land in 1-3 minutes and bank transfers within 5-15 minutes. If it has been over 30 minutes, send me the deposit order number or tap "Talk to a human" so an agent can trace it.
lobby.support.reply.withdraw: Withdrawals are paid once approved: e-wallets usually in 5-30 minutes, bank cards in 1-2 business days. Check each request's status in My Account. If it still shows Under Review, please wait a little longer or ask a human agent to escalate.
lobby.support.reply.bonus: Bonus funds can be withdrawn after the wagering requirement is met. Open Missions / Promotions to see claimable rewards and remaining turnover. Most promotions can only be claimed once.
lobby.support.reply.account: For login or sign-up issues, double-check your username, password and verification code. Repeated failures trigger a temporary lock — wait 10 minutes, or use Forgot Password. If you still cannot sign in, ask for a human agent.
lobby.support.reply.game: Lag is usually caused by your network or the provider's route. Refresh the page and try another connection first. If only one game is affected, tell me its name and I'll log it for the technical team.
lobby.support.reply.human: Connecting you to a human agent. Please add your login name, the issue type, and any screenshots or order numbers so the agent can follow up quickly. Human support hours: 09:00-24:00 (GMT+8) daily.
lobby.support.reply.fallback: I didn't quite catch that. Try rephrasing, or pick one of the quick questions below. If you need a person, tap "Talk to a human" and I'll hand the conversation over.
